data.title: 雪之下雪乃 · 暖桌冬夜
data.description: 【雪之下雪乃 · 暖桌冬夜】冬夜窗外细雪纷飞，屋内暖桌散发着让人沉沦的温暖。雪乃整个人缩在毛毯与暖桌间，怀里抱着一只毛绒猫咪玩偶，双颊被烘得泛着红晕——「进入暖桌之后……确实连站起来的意志都会被瓦解呢。今晚就允许你和我一起在这多呆一会儿。」
data.action: 穿针织家居服坐在暖桌毯边，双臂抱猫咪毛绒玩偶，脸颊微微泛暖
data.promptProse: Yukino holds a plush cat in both arms above the kotatsu blanket, looking down with a rare relaxed smile. Long-sleeved knit top, lounge trousers and warm socks retain the indoor outfit. The medium view includes quilt folds beside the warm tabletop and snowfall beyond the window. Kotatsu glow warms the blanket's lower edge, while the table lamp illuminates black hair and blue eyes, leaving gentle contact shade around the toy's soft body.
